eventDetail.eventTitle: 2026 3rd International Conference on Computational Systems and Communication (ICCSC)
eventDetail.about: Communication, Networking and Broadcast Technologies; Computing and Processing; Robotics and Control Systems; Signal Processing and Analysis
eventDetail.sponsors: Department of Science & Technology,  Government of India; Kerala Section; LBS Institute of Technology for Women
eventDetail.scope: The scope of the conference covers a broad range of topics related to computing technologies, communication systems, and their interdisciplinary applications. The conference will incorporate, but not be limited to, the following topics: • Wireless communications and Mobile Networks (5G, and beyond) • RF circuits, systems and antennas • Signal and Image Processing • Cognitive Radio & Spectrum Management • Microelectronics, MEMS and Nano technologies • Optical and satellite communication Technologies • Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning • Cloud Computing and Big Data Analytics • Cybersecurity and Data Privacy • Internet of Things (IoT) and Smart Systems • Blockchain and Cryptographic Systems • Quantum Computing and Emerging Technologies • Human-Computer Interaction and Virtual Reality • Robotics, Control and Automation • Green and Sustainable Communication Technologies • Health care – devices and technologies
eventDetail.venues: LBSITW, LBS Institute of Technology for Women , Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, Thiruvananthapuram, , India, 695012, ;
